subject: astronomy

source.track: GCSE · ages 14–16 · Topics 1–8 examined in Paper 1 (Naked-eye Astronomy); Topics 9–16 in Paper 2 (Telescopic Astronomy)

note: Units follow the specification's sixteen numbered topics, taught in order and grouped by the two assessment papers. Naked-eye (Paper 1) topics anchor the foundational and intermediate lessons; telescopic (Paper 2) topics carry the intermediate, advanced and expert lessons.

program.title: Planet Earth
topics: 1.1–1.2 The Earth as an oblate spheroid and its mean diameter
1.3 The Earth's major internal divisions
1.4–1.5 Latitude, longitude and the divisions of the Earth's surface
1.6 Effects of the Earth's atmosphere on observation

program.title: The lunar disc
topics: 2.1–2.4 Shape, structure and principal features of the Moon
